plugin.description: .----------------------------------------------------------------------------. | Madrox Button Plugin | | Written by Kelaire | | Fresh-install defaults and later changes by Madrox | |----------------------------------------------------------------------------| |madbutt help -- Brings up the help section. (What you are reading now) | | | |--- Window Commands --- | |madbutt show -- Start displaying the miniwindow. | |madbutt hide -- Stop displaying the miniwindow. | |madbutt reset -- Resets miniwindow position and size. | |madbutt lock / unlock -- lock the window in place (also mb lock/mb unlock) | | Locked by default. Right-click the title bar to lock/unlock too. | | "aard layout lock" also stops it moving, like the other windows. | |madbutt setcols -- Without an argument show # of columns, otherwise can | | send 1, 2, or 3 to set columns | | | |--- Button Commands --- | |madbutt addbutton # # BUTTON command -- adds a button taking 4 arguments: | | #1 - 1, 2, or 3 (Column of Button) | | #2 - Row Position (numeric) | | BUTTON - text to display on button, probably limit | | yourself to 3 characters | | command - command to send on button press. | |madbutt default - Puts the Default buttons (mb2 on a new install) on the | | active set | |New installs start with mb1 = a menu of buttons for mb2 - mb20, and | |mb2 = the Default buttons. Sets 3 - 40 start empty for your own. | |madbutt clear - Deletes all buttons. Use with caution. No refunds. | |madbutt save - saves your buttons | |madbutt removebutton # # - Removes a button | | | |--- Color Functions --- | |madbutt setcolor # # hexcolor -- Sets the color of an individual button! | |madbutt setcolor # # XTERM -- Set the button color using XTERM colors | |madbutt setcolor # # colorname -- Set the button color using the color table| |madbutt color add name value -- Add a color to the color table | | madbutt color add cobalt #0047AB | | madbutt color add warn x196 | | madbutt color add steelblue steelblue | |madbutt color remove name -- Remove the named color | |madbutt colors -- List the colormap | | | |--- Sample Hex Colors! --- | | White #FFFFFF | | Silver #C0C0C0 | | Gray #808080 | | Black #000000 | | Red #FF0000 | | Maroon #800000 | | Yellow #FFFF00 | | Olive #808000 | | Lime #00FF00 | | Green #008000 | | Aqua #00FFFF | | Teal #008080 | | Blue #0000FF | | Navy #000080 | | Fuchsia #FF00FF | | Purple #800080 | | | |--- Button Set Commands --- | |madbutt sets -- Display the button sets | |madbutt setname name -- Sets the name for the ACTIVE set | |madbutt setname set name -- Sets the name for a specified set | |madbutt buttonset set -- changes the set | | Can specify either set # or set name! | |mb# -- shortcut to change set: mb1, mb2 ... mb40 | |mb config -- opens the MB Config window to edit a whole set at once | |madbutt copyset from to -- copies a whole set over another: copyset 2 40 | | | |--- Display Commands --- | |madbutt list - lists all buttons | |madbutt listmap - lists command mappings | | | '----------------------------------------------------------------------------'

require "serialize"
-- Package window library, used only by the MB Config editor window. -- If it is missing the main button window still works; "mb config" says so. local gHaveTheme = pcall (require, "themed_miniwindows")
local map_table = {} local buttonMap = {} local setNames = {} local CMD_MAP = {} local colorSets = colorSets or {} local colorMap = {} -- points to colorSets[activeSet] local buttonSets = buttonSets or {} local cmdSets = cmdSets or {} local numCols = 2 -- default to 2 columns local MAX_SETS = 40 -- number of button sets (mb1 .. mb40) local MAX_POS = 14 -- More than 14 buttons goes off screen more than likely. local activeSet = tonumber(GetVariable("madbutt_active_set")) or 1
-- Colors? local namedColors = namedColors or { BLACK="#000000", WHITE="#FFFFFF", SILVER="#C0C0C0", GRAY="#808080", RED="#FF0000", MAROON="#800000", YELLOW="#FFFF00", OLIVE="#808000", LIME="#00FF00", GREEN="#008000", AQUA="#00FFFF", TEAL="#008080", BLUE="#0000FF", NAVY="#000080", FUCHSIA="#FF00FF", PURPLE="#800080", ORANGE="#FFA500", GOLD="#FFD700", PINK="#FFC0CB", HOTPINK="#FF69B4", DEEPSKYBLUE="#00BFFF", SKYBLUE="#87CEEB", DODGERBLUE="#1E90FF", CORNFLOWERBLUE="#6495ED", VIOLET="#EE82EE", INDIGO="#4B0082", }
-- Window variables local z_order_plugin = "462b665ecb569efbf261422f" local dragStart = nil local window = {} local currRoom = {}
-- Pinned window geometry: madbutt always loads at this exact spot/size local MADBUTT_PIN = { left = 1090, top = 26, width = 201, height = 638 }
-- Position lock (v1.4). Locked by default, at MADBUTT_PIN. Unlocked, a drag -- or resize is remembered (madbutt_pin_*) and used on every load; locking -- keeps it wherever it is. "madbutt reset" goes back to MADBUTT_PIN. -- The window also refuses to move while the package layout lock -- ("aard layout lock", plugin c293f9e7...) is on, like the package windows. local LAYOUT_PLUGIN = "c293f9e7f04dde889f65cb90" local PIN_KEYS = { "left", "top", "width", "height" } local posLocked = (GetVariable ("madbutt_locked") or "1") == "1"
function layoutLocked () return GetPluginVariable (LAYOUT_PLUGIN, "lock_down_miniwindows") == "1" end
function windowLocked () return posLocked or layoutLocked () end
local function savedPin () local p = {} for _, k in ipairs (PIN_KEYS) do p [k] = tonumber (GetVariable ("madbutt_pin_" .. k)) or MADBUTT_PIN [k] end return p end
local function savePin () for _, k in ipairs (PIN_KEYS) do if window [k] then SetVariable ("madbutt_pin_" .. k, tostring (window [k])) end end end
local function clearPin () for _, k in ipairs (PIN_KEYS) do DeleteVariable ("madbutt_pin_" .. k) end end
-- Drawing related variables local colours = { bgGridButton = {A = "#333333", B = "#333333", C = "#333333", D = "#333333", E = "#333333", F = "#333333", G = "#333333"}, bgGridButtonHighlight = "#8a8a8a", bgButton = "#333333", mazeColour = "#ff35a0", bgButtonHighlight = "#8a8a8a", selectedCommand = "green", selectedCommandHighlight = "palegreen", selectedCommandText = "lime", header = "#474747", } local headerSize = 20 local sizeHeight = 60 local sizeWidth = 90 local gridWidth = 0 --This will update upon drawing, needed for hotspots. local gridBottom = 0 --This will update upon drawing, needed for hotspots. local showZeros = tonumber(GetVariable("showZeros")) or 1 local recoveryMax = 10 local recoveryCur = 10
-- === Grid layout (single source of truth) === local GRID_TOP = GRID_TOP or headerSize + 4 -- vertical offset from top of window to row 1 (tweak this to close the gap) local ROW_H = ROW_H or (sizeHeight or 28) local COL_W = COL_W or (sizeWidth or 100) local COL_GAP = COL_GAP or 5 local COL_A_X = COL_A_X or 20 local COL_B_X = COL_B_X or (COL_A_X + COL_W + COL_GAP) local COL_C_X = COL_C_X or (COL_B_X + COL_W + COL_GAP)
-- visualIndex is 1,2,3... (top to bottom) function row_y(visualIndex) return GRID_TOP + (visualIndex - 1) * ROW_H end
-- Return rect for a cell (x1,y1,x2,y2) using visualIndex and column "A"/"B"/"C" function cell_rect(visualIndex, col) local x1 = (col == "A" and COL_A_X) or (col == "B" and COL_B_X) or COL_C_X local y1 = row_y(visualIndex) local x2 = x1 + COL_W local y2 = y1 + ROW_H return x1, y1, x2, y2 end
function OnPluginSaveState() -- make sure current globals are stored into the containers buttonSets[activeSet] = buttonMap cmdSets[activeSet] = CMD_MAP
SetVariable("madbutt_buttonsets", serialize.save_simple(buttonSets)) SetVariable("madbutt_commandsets", serialize.save_simple(cmdSets)) SetVariable("madbutt_setnames", serialize.save_simple(setNames)) SetVariable("madbutt_named_colors", serialize.save_simple(namedColors)) SetVariable("madbutt_active_set", tostring(activeSet)) SetVariable("madbutt_colorsets", serialize.save_simple(colorSets)) end
function OnPluginInstall() resetButtonData() -- will load sets or migrate single-set state syncActiveTables() -- make buttonMap/CMD_MAP point at the active set
local s = GetVariable("madbutt_win") if s and s ~= "" then local luastmt = "obj = " .. s local fn, err = loadstring(luastmt) if fn and pcall(fn) and type(obj) == "table" then window = obj window.fontSize = 25 else SetWindowDefaults() end else SetWindowDefaults() end
InitializeWindow() -- pins the window geometry (see MADBUTT_PIN) end
function SetWindowDefaults() window = { id = "window_" .. GetPluginID(), top = MADBUTT_PIN.top, left = MADBUTT_PIN.left, width = MADBUTT_PIN.width, height = MADBUTT_PIN.height, show = true, font = "defaultFont", fontFamily = "Consolas", fontSize = 25, fontColor = "white", borderColor = "lightgray", backgroundColor = "black" } end
function SetFontSize(name, line, args) if args.buttonsize ~= nil then buttsize = args.buttonsize ColourNote("Red","",buttsize) window.fontSize = tonumber(buttsize) WindowFont(window.id, window.font, window.fontFamily, window.fontSize, false, false, false, false, 1, 0) end end
function AddButton(name, line, args) local pos = tonumber(args.position) if not pos or pos < 1 then return ColourNote("red","","Position must be a positive number.") end if pos > MAX_POS then return ColourNote("red","","Position too large (max "..MAX_POS..").") end
local col = ({["1"]="A", ["2"]="B", ["3"]="C"})[tostring(args.column)] if not col then return ColourNote("red","","Column must be 1-3.") end
local buttname = args.buttonname local buttcmd = args.buttoncommand if not (buttname and buttcmd) then return ColourNote("red","","Need button name and command.") end
buttonMap[pos] = buttonMap[pos] or {} buttonMap[pos][col] = buttname
CMD_MAP = CMD_MAP or {} CMD_MAP[buttname] = buttcmd
-- persist current set buttonSets[activeSet] = buttonMap cmdSets[activeSet] = CMD_MAP SetVariable("madbutt_buttonsets", serialize.save_simple(buttonSets)) SetVariable("madbutt_commandsets", serialize.save_simple(cmdSets)) SetVariable("madbutt_active_set", tostring(activeSet))
Draw(window) CreateHotSpots() end
function ClearButtons(name, line, args) if args.confirm ~= "CONFIRM" then ColourNote("Red","","Madbutt: This will clear ALL buttons. Add CONFIRM to confirm choice.") return else ColourNote("Red","","Madbutt: Hope you meant to do that! All buttons cleared.") buttonMap = {} colorMap = {} CMD_MAP = {} end SaveButtons() ResetWindow(true) end
function RemoveButton(name, line, args) if args.column == nil or args.position == nil then ColourNote("Red","","Incorrect usage. Correct call is 'madbutt removebutton column position'") return end
thepos = tonumber(args.position)
if thepos > MAX_POS then return ColourNote("red","","Position too large (max "..MAX_POS..").") end
if args.column == "1" then thecol = "A" elseif args.column == "2" then thecol = "B" elseif args.column == "3" then thecol = "C" else ColourNote("Red","","Sorry, columns beyond three not currently supported.") return end
if args.confirm ~= "CONFIRM" then ColourNote("Red","","Madbutt: This will remove the button " .. buttonMap[thepos][thecol] .. ". Add CONFIRM to confirm choice.") return else removeCell(thepos, thecol) end SaveButtons() Draw(window) end
function removeCell(pos, col) local row = buttonMap[pos] if not row then return end
local name = row[col] -- the alias/key in CMD_MAP row[col] = nil -- remove from the grid
-- drop the row if now empty if next(row) == nil then buttonMap[pos] = nil end
-- Only delete CMD_MAP[name] if it's not used elsewhere if name and not name_in_use_elsewhere(name, pos, col) then CMD_MAP[name] = nil end
-- persist (if you save state) if serialize and serialize.save_simple then SetVariable("madbutt_buttonmap", serialize.save_simple(buttonMap)) end
-- also drop color for this cell if colorMap[pos] then colorMap[pos][col] = nil if next(colorMap[pos]) == nil then colorMap[pos] = nil end end end
function name_in_use_elsewhere(name, skip_pos, skip_col) if not name then return false end for pos, row in pairs(buttonMap) do if type(row) == "table" then for col, n in pairs(row) do if n == name and not (pos == skip_pos and col == skip_col) then return true end end end end return false end
function SetCols(name, line, args) if args.numcols == "" then ColourNote("Red","","Madbutt: Columns currently set to " .. numCols) return end newcols = tonumber(args.numcols) if newcols > 3 or newcols < 1 then ColourNote("Red","","Madbutt: Sorry limited to three columns.") else numCols = newcols ColourNote("Red","","Madbutt: Columns set to " .. numCols) end
SaveButtons() Draw(window) end
function ListButtons(name, line, args) local top = max_index(buttonMap)
if top == 0 then ColourNote("Red","","No Buttons Defined!") return end
ColourNote("Red","",top .. " Rows Defined!")
for i = top, 1, -1 do local row = buttonMap[i] or {} if row.A then ColourNote("Red","","Column 1, Position "..i.." "..row.A) end if row.B then ColourNote("Red","","Column 2, Position "..i.." "..row.B) end if row.C then ColourNote("Red","","Column 3, Position "..i.." "..row.C) end end end
function ListCommandMap(name, line, args) for name, cmd in pairs(CMD_MAP) do Note(string.format("%s => %s", name, cmd)) end end
function SaveButtons(name, line, args) -- make sure current globals are in the set containers buttonSets[activeSet] = buttonMap cmdSets[activeSet] = CMD_MAP
SetVariable("madbutt_buttonsets", serialize.save_simple(buttonSets)) SetVariable("madbutt_commandsets", serialize.save_simple(cmdSets)) SetVariable("madbutt_colorsets", serialize.save_simple(colorSets)) SetVariable("madbutt_active_set", tostring(activeSet)) SetVariable("madbutt_setnames", serialize.save_simple(setNames)) SaveState() -- write the plugin state file to disk now, not just at close ColourNote("Red","","Madbutt: Buttons Saved.") end
-- deep copy of a plain table (button/command/color maps) local function copyTable (t) if type (t) ~= "table" then return t end local c = {} for k, v in pairs (t) do c [k] = copyTable (v) end return c end
-- "madbutt copyset <from> <to>": overwrite set <to> with a copy of set <from> -- (buttons, commands, colors and name) function CopyButtonSet (name, line, args) local from, to = tonumber (args.from), tonumber (args.to) if not from or not to or from < 1 or to < 1 or from > MAX_SETS or to > MAX_SETS then return ColourNote ("red", "", "Madbutt: sets must be 1-" .. MAX_SETS .. ".") end if from == to then return ColourNote ("red", "", "Madbutt: from and to are the same set.") end
-- the active set's working tables may have been replaced; put them back first buttonSets [activeSet] = buttonMap cmdSets [activeSet] = CMD_MAP colorSets [activeSet] = colorMap
ensureSet (from); ensureName (from) buttonSets [to] = copyTable (buttonSets [from]) cmdSets [to] = copyTable (cmdSets [from]) colorSets [to] = copyTable (colorSets [from]) setNames [to] = setNames [from]
syncActiveTables () SaveButtons () Draw (window) CreateHotSpots () ColourNote ("orange", "", string.format ('Madbutt: Copied set %d ("%s") into set %d.', from, setNames [from], to)) end
function InitializeWindow() -- Pin: the saved spot (or MADBUTT_PIN) every time the window is (re)built local pin = savedPin () window.left = pin.left window.top = pin.top window.width = pin.width window.height = pin.height WindowCreate(window.id, window.left, window.top, window.width, window.height, miniwin.pos_center_all, miniwin.create_keep_hotspots, ColourNameToRGB(window.backgroundColor)) WindowFont(window.id, window.font, window.fontFamily, window.fontSize, false, false, false, false, 1, 0) WindowFont(window.id, "headerFont", "Consolas", 9, false, false, false, false, 1, 0) -- Pin: always place at the fixed position WindowPosition(window.id, window.left, window.top, miniwin.pos_stretch_to_view, miniwin.create_absolute_location)
if (window.show) then WindowShow(window.id, window.show) if (IsPluginInstalled(z_order_plugin) and GetPluginInfo(z_order_plugin, 17)) then CallPlugin(z_order_plugin, "boostMe", window.id) end Draw(window) end CreateHotSpots() end
function CreateHotSpots() WindowDeleteAllHotspots(window.id)
-- Drag window local locked = windowLocked() local lockTip = posLocked and "Locked in place - right-click to unlock" or "Layout is locked (aard layout unlock)" WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "DragArea", 15, 0, window.width-15, headerSize, "", "", "", "", "mouseup", locked and lockTip or "Drag to move - right-click to lock", locked and (miniwin.cursor_arrow or 0) or miniwin.cursor_both_arrow, 0) WindowDragHandler(window.id, "DragArea", "dragmove", "dragrelease", 0)
-- Resize window WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "Resize", window.width-13, window.height-13, window.width-2, window.height-2, "", "", "", "", "mouseup", locked and lockTip or "Drag to resize", locked and (miniwin.cursor_arrow or 0) or miniwin.cursor_nw_se_arrow, 0) WindowDragHandler(window.id, "Resize", "resizemove", "resizerelease", 0)
-- Help button (?) WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "DisplayHelp", 0, 0, 15, 15, "", "", "", "", "buttonmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0)
-- Close button (x) WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "CloseMiniwindow", window.width-15, 0, window.width, 15, "", "", "", "", "buttonmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0)
---------------------------------------------------------------- -- Grid button hotspots (match the rectangles drawn in Draw) ----------------------------------------------------------------
local keys = sorted_numeric_keys_capped(buttonMap, MAX_POS) local rows = #keys
for v = 1, rows do local pos = keys[v] local row = buttonMap[pos] or {}
-- A do local x1,y1,x2,y2 = cell_rect(v, "A") local id = string.format("BTN_%d_A", pos) WindowAddHotspot(window.id, id, x1, y1, x2, y2, "", "", "", "", "gridbuttonmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) WindowHotspotTooltip(window.id, id, string.format("Row %d (pos %d) A: %s", v, pos, row.A or " ")) end
-- B if numCols >= 2 then local x1,y1,x2,y2 = cell_rect(v, "B") local id = string.format("BTN_%d_B", pos) WindowAddHotspot(window.id, id, x1, y1, x2, y2, "", "", "", "", "gridbuttonmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) WindowHotspotTooltip(window.id, id, string.format("Row %d (pos %d) B: %s", v, pos, row.B or " ")) end
-- C if numCols == 3 then local x1,y1,x2,y2 = cell_rect(v, "C") local id = string.format("BTN_%d_C", pos) WindowAddHotspot(window.id, id, x1, y1, x2, y2, "", "", "", "", "gridbuttonmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) WindowHotspotTooltip(window.id, id, string.format("Row %d (pos %d) C: %s", v, pos, row.C or " ")) end end end
function ShowWindow() window.show = true WindowShow(window.id, true) if (IsPluginInstalled(z_order_plugin) and GetPluginInfo(z_order_plugin, 17)) then CallPlugin(z_order_plugin, "boostMe", window.id) end Draw(window) CreateHotSpots() SaveWindow() end
function HideWindow() window.show = false WindowShow(window.id, false) Draw(window) SaveWindow() end
-- Call: ResetWindow(true) to keep position; ResetWindow() to use defaults function ResetWindow(preservePos) local keepX, keepY
-- if window exists, remember its current top-left if preservePos and WindowInfo(window.id, 1) == 1 then keepX = WindowInfo(window.id, 2) -- left keepY = WindowInfo(window.id, 3) -- top end
-- tear down & rebuild if WindowInfo(window.id, 1) == 1 then WindowDelete(window.id) end InitializeWindow() -- this should Create + Draw + CreateHotSpots
-- put it back where it was if preservePos and keepX and keepY then WindowPosition(window.id, keepX, keepY, miniwin.pos_stretch_to_view, miniwin.create_absolute_location) -- absolute position Draw(window) CreateHotSpots() end end
function SaveWindow() SetVariable("madbutt_win", serialize.save_simple(window)) SetVariable("madbutt_buttonmap", serialize.save_simple(buttonMap)) SetVariable("madbutt_commandmap", serialize.save_simple(CMD_MAP)) end
function Draw(win) -- miniwin background WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_fill , 0, 0, win.width, win.height, ColourNameToRGB(window.backgroundColor))
-- resize bars WindowLine(win.id, win.width-3, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-3, ColourNameToRGB(window.borderColor), 0, 2) WindowLine(win.id, win.width-4, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-4, ColourNameToRGB(window.backgroundColor), 0, 1) WindowLine(win.id, win.width-6, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-6, ColourNameToRGB(window.borderColor), 0, 2) WindowLine(win.id, win.width-7, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-7, ColourNameToRGB(window.backgroundColor), 0, 1) WindowLine(win.id, win.width-9, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-9, ColourNameToRGB(window.borderColor), 0, 2) WindowLine(win.id, win.width-10, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-10, ColourNameToRGB(window.backgroundColor), 0, 1) WindowLine(win.id, win.width-12, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-12, ColourNameToRGB(window.borderColor), 0, 2) WindowLine(win.id, win.width-13, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-13, ColourNameToRGB(window.backgroundColor), 0, 1)
-- Header WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_fill , 0, 0, window.width, headerSize, ColourNameToRGB(colours.header)) local title = string.format("MADBUTT - %s", activeSetName()) WindowText(win.id, "headerFont", title, (window.width)/2-(WindowTextWidth(win.id, "headerFont", title)/2), 3, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB("white"), true) WindowText(win.id, "headerFont", "x", window.width-15, 3, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB("white"), true) WindowText(win.id, "headerFont", "?", 5, 3, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB("white"), true)
--Window outline WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_3d_rect , 0, 0, win.width, win.height, ColourNameToRGB(window.borderColor), ColourNameToRGB(window.borderColor))
-- Grid Layout -- Grid Layout local keys = sorted_numeric_keys_capped(buttonMap, MAX_POS) local rows = #keys gridBottom = GRID_TOP -- reset bottom tracker
for v = 1, rows do local pos = keys[v] local row = buttonMap[pos] or {}
-- stripe color by visual index if v % 2 == 1 then colours.mazeColour = "#A1FF35" else colours.mazeColour = "#FF35A0" end

-- Hex for button color function normalize_hex(h) -- strip leading '#', normalize case h = (h or ""):gsub("^#", ""):upper()
if h:match("^%x%x%x$") then -- expand #RGB to #RRGGBB return string.format("#%s%s%s%s%s%s", h:sub(1,1), h:sub(1,1), h:sub(2,2), h:sub(2,2), h:sub(3,3), h:sub(3,3)) elseif h:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then return "#" .. h else return nil end end
-- Expand hex from 3 to 6 characters function expand_hex3(h) -- "ABC" -> "#AABBCC" return ("#%s%s%s%s%s%s"):format(h:sub(1,1), h:sub(1,1), h:sub(2,2), h:sub(2,2), h:sub(3,3), h:sub(3,3)) end
-- Allow XTERM colors as input function ansi256_to_hex(n) n = tonumber(n) if not n or n < 0 or n > 255 then return nil end if n < 16 then -- standard 16 local base = { [0]=0x000000,[1]=0x800000,[2]=0x008000,[3]=0x808000,[4]=0x000080,[5]=0x800080,[6]=0x008080,[7]=0xC0C0C0, [8]=0x808080,[9]=0xFF0000,[10]=0x00FF00,[11]=0xFFFF00,[12]=0x0000FF,[13]=0xFF00FF,[14]=0x00FFFF,[15]=0xFFFFFF } return ("#%06X"):format(base[n]) elseif n >= 16 and n <= 231 then -- 6x6x6 cube: indices 16..231 local idx = n - 16 local r = math.floor(idx / 36) % 6 local g = math.floor(idx / 6) % 6 local b = idx % 6 local function cv(v) return (v==0) and 0 or (v*40 + 55) end return ("#%02X%02X%02X"):format(cv(r), cv(g), cv(b)) else -- grayscale 232..255 (24 steps from 8..238) local level = 8 + (n - 232) * 10 return ("#%02X%02X%02X"):format(level, level, level) end end
-- Normalize user input to "#RRGGBB" or return nil on bad input function normalize_color(input) if not input or input == "" then return nil end local s = tostring(input):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","") local up = s:upper()
-- ANSI256 first: "x<N>" or just "<N>" (0..255). A bare number like 196 -- is xterm, NOT #RGB shorthand (it used to become #119966). Type #196 -- if you really mean the 3-digit hex. Over 255 is rejected. local n = up:match("^X(%d%d?%d?)$") or up:match("^(%d%d?%d?)$") if n then return ansi256_to_hex(n) end
-- HEX #RGB / #RRGGBB (with or without #) local hex = up:gsub("^#","") if hex:match("^%x%x%x$") then return expand_hex3(hex) end if hex:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then return "#" .. hex end
-- Named colors if namedColors[up] then return namedColors[up] end
return nil end

-- write one draft back into the real set tables (no saving to disk here) local function cfgCommit (s, d) ensureSet (s) local bs, cm, oldCs = buttonSets [s], colorSets [s], cmdSets [s]
for i, sp in ipairs (d.spots) do local pos, col = cfgSpotPos (i) if sp.name ~= "" then bs [pos] = bs [pos] or {} bs [pos] [col] = sp.name elseif bs [pos] then bs [pos] [col] = nil if next (bs [pos]) == nil then bs [pos] = nil end end if sp.name ~= "" and sp.color ~= "" then cm [pos] = cm [pos] or {} cm [pos] [col] = sp.color elseif cm [pos] then cm [pos] [col] = nil if next (cm [pos]) == nil then cm [pos] = nil end end end
-- rebuild the command map from every name still on the grid, so rows -- 11-14 and column C (not shown in the editor) keep their commands local fromDraft = {} for _, sp in ipairs (d.spots) do if sp.name ~= "" and not fromDraft [sp.name] then fromDraft [sp.name] = sp end end local newCs = {} for _, row in pairs (bs) do if type (row) == "table" then for _, nm in pairs (row) do local sp = fromDraft [nm] if sp then if sp.cmd ~= "" then -- unchanged text keeps the original value (it may be a list) if sp.cmd == sp.o_cmd and sp.o_raw ~= nil then newCs [nm] = sp.o_raw else newCs [nm] = sp.cmd end end elseif oldCs [nm] ~= nil then newCs [nm] = oldCs [nm] end end end end cmdSets [s] = newCs setNames [s] = d.name end
local function cfgFit (font, s, maxw) if WindowTextWidth (CFG_ID, font, s) <= maxw then return s end while #s > 0 and WindowTextWidth (CFG_ID, font, s .. "...") > maxw do s = s:sub (1, -2) end return s .. "..." end

L.spotX = l + CFG_PAD; L.spotW = 72 L.nameX = L.spotX + L.spotW + CFG_GAP; L.nameW = 100 L.cmdX = L.nameX + L.nameW + CFG_GAP; L.cmdW = 280 L.colX = L.cmdX + L.cmdW + CFG_GAP; L.colW = 110 L.right = L.colX + L.colW
local y = t + CFG_PAD L.barY = y L.setLblX = L.spotX L.dropX = L.setLblX + WindowTextWidth (CFG_ID, "mbc_b", "Set:") + 6 L.dropW = 230 L.snLblX = L.dropX + L.dropW + 16 L.snX = L.snLblX + WindowTextWidth (CFG_ID, "mbc_b", "Set name:") + 6 L.snW = L.right - L.snX y = y + CFG_BOX_H + 1 + 12 L.headY = y y = y + fh + 6 L.rowsY = y y = y + CFG_SPOTS * CFG_ROW_H + 6 L.statusY = y y = y + fh + 8 L.saveY = y y = y + fh + 2 * 4 + 6 + CFG_PAD

-- full text on hover, since long commands are cut off WindowHotspotTooltip (CFG_ID, "mbc_c_" .. i .. "_name", cfgSpotLabel (i) .. " name: " .. local function cfgOnDelete () cfgWin = nil cfgDrafts = {} cfgStatus = nil cfgL = nil end
local function cfgClose () if cfgWin then cfgWin:delete (true) end -- deferred: we are inside a click end
local function cfgPickSet () local items = {} for s = 1, MAX_SETS do ensureName (s) local d = cfgDrafts [s] local nm = (d and d.name or setNames [s]):gsub ("|", "/"):gsub ("&", "&&") local mark = (s == cfgSet) and "+" or "" local star = (d and cfgDirty (d)) and " *" or "" items [#items + 1] = string.format ("%smb%d %s%s", mark, s, nm, star) end local r = tonumber (WindowMenu (CFG_ID, cfgL.dropX, cfgL.barY + CFG_BOX_H, "!" .. table.concat (items, "|"))) if r and r >= 1 and r <= MAX_SETS then cfgSet = r cfgStatus = nil cfgDraw () end end
local function cfgEditSetName () local d = cfgLoadDraft (cfgSet) local v = utils.inputbox ("Name for button set mb" .. cfgSet .. ":", "MB Config", d.name) if v == nil then return end v = trim (v) if v == "" then cfgStatus = { text = "A set name cannot be blank.", colour = CLR_ERR } else d.name = v cfgStatus = nil end cfgDraw () end
local function cfgEditField (i, field) local d = cfgLoadDraft (cfgSet) local sp = d.spots [i] if not sp then return end local where = "mb" .. cfgSet .. ", " .. cfgSpotLabel (i) cfgStatus = nil
if field == "name" then local v = utils.inputbox ("Button name for " .. where .. "\r\n(blank removes the button)", "MB Config", sp.name) if v == nil then return end sp.name = trim (v) -- a name already used in this set shares that button's command if sp.name ~= "" and sp.cmd == "" then for j, other in ipairs (d.spots) do if j ~= i and other.name == sp.name and other.cmd ~= "" then sp.cmd = other.cmd break end end end
elseif field == "cmd" then local who = (sp.name ~= "" and sp.name) or cfgSpotLabel (i) local v = utils.inputbox ("Command to send for " .. who .. " (" .. where .. ")", "MB Config", sp.cmd) if v == nil then return end sp.cmd = trim (v) -- same name = same command, so keep the other spots in step if sp.name ~= "" then local also = {} for j, other in ipairs (d.spots) do if j ~= i and other.name == sp.name and other.cmd ~= sp.cmd then other.cmd = sp.cmd also [#also + 1] = cfgSpotLabel (j) end end if #also > 0 then cfgStatus = { text = "Also updated " .. table.concat (also, ", ") .. " (same name).", colour = CLR_HI } end end
elseif field == "color" then local v = utils.inputbox ("Text color for " .. where .. "\r\nxterm number 0-255, e.g. 196 for red.\r\nBlank = the normal stripe color.", "MB Config", (sp.color ~= "" and cfgXterm (sp.color)) or "") if v == nil then return end v = trim (v):gsub ("^@", "") -- accept 196, x196 or @x196 if v == "" then sp.color = "" else local c = normalize_color (v) if not c then cfgStatus = { text = '"' .. v .. '" is not a color. Use an xterm number 0-255, e.g. 196.', colour = CLR_ERR } else sp.color = c end end end
cfgDraw () end
-- hotspot callback for every box in the config window (must be global) function MBC_Click (flags, hotspot_id) if bit.band (flags, miniwin.hotspot_got_rh_mouse) ~= 0 then return end if not cfgWin then return end if hotspot_id == "mbc_drop" then return cfgPickSet () end if hotspot_id == "mbc_setname" then return cfgEditSetName () end local i, field = hotspot_id:match ("^mbc_c_(%d+)_(%a+)$") if i then cfgEditField (tonumber (i), field) end end
function MBC_Save () if not cfgWin then return end
for s = 1, MAX_SETS do local d = cfgDrafts [s] if d and cfgDirty (d) then local err = cfgConflict (d) if err then cfgSet = s cfgStatus = { text = "mb" .. s .. ": " .. err, colour = CLR_ERR } cfgDraw () return end end end
local saved = {} for s = 1, MAX_SETS do local d = cfgDrafts [s] if d and cfgDirty (d) then cfgCommit (s, d) saved [#saved + 1] = "mb" .. s end end
if #saved > 0 then syncActiveTables () SetVariable ("madbutt_buttonsets", serialize.save_simple (buttonSets)) SetVariable ("madbutt_commandsets", serialize.save_simple (cmdSets)) SetVariable ("madbutt_colorsets", serialize.save_simple (colorSets)) SetVariable ("madbutt_setnames", serialize.save_simple (setNames)) SaveState () -- write the plugin state file to disk now Draw (window) CreateHotSpots () mbEcho ("Saved ", table.concat (saved, ", ")) else mbEcho ("Nothing changed, nothing saved.") end cfgClose () end
